name: Quibbly
description: LinkedIn inbox for AI assistants, synced by the Quibbly Chrome extension: read conversations and connections, see who watched your videos, set follow-ups and notes, and draft replies that you send with one click; never sends on its own and works alongside any CRM. OAuth 2.1 or personal access token, paid plans with a 3-day free trial. Endpoint: `https://server.quibbly.co/mcp` · [Docs](https://quibbly.co/docs/mcp) · Registry: `co.quibbly/linkedin-inbox`
